decision_cruda.rationale: The radio (LH-03 hydraulic failure at N574-02) and the CMMS (OT-5100, hydraulic, on-site repair, 0.25-0.5 h, likely 0.4 h) agree, so no confirmation is needed. The repair is short, so LH-03 is back around 09:55-10:00 and a loan would arrive about when it finishes. Norte is truck-limited. It has 3 trucks, with a cycle of about 0.43 h and 40 t payload at factor 0.227, which gives roughly 63 t/h. LH-01 and LH-02 alone muck about 36 t/h each at 220 m, roughly 71 t/h. The Norte stockpile holds 242 t of 450 t, so trucks keep hauling while LH-03 is down and little is lost. A loan would need a lender from another mine. Central and Este loaders would face long travel (Central to Norte is 6 km of surface plus ramps), and the lender's home stope or heading would lose production. DS-E543-02 costs 4.0 oz per hour, and the other lenders would also lose output. The gain from a loan is below its cost, so I make no moves. There is no stopped stope, so no reserve is activated. Expected gain versus doing nothing is 0 oz.

confirmations_requested.ask: Call the Norte area chief. Confirm that LH-03 is down for the hydraulic failure and that OT-5101 (part not in stock, 5-8 h from 09:30) replaces the 0.25-0.5 h on-site estimate in OT-5100. The radio log only has the 09:30 call. If the repair is actually short, nothing needs to move.

decision_cruda.rationale: Norte: with LH-03 down, LH-01 and LH-02 each muck about 35.6 t/h, so about 71 t/h together. The 3 Norte trucks haul roughly 66 t/h, and the stockpile already holds 245 t of 450 t. Norte is truck-limited, so a replacement loader at N574-02 adds almost nothing, and no loader is free to lend anyway. I leave it uncovered. Central: LH-04, LH-06 and LH-07 muck about 96 t/h against 4 trucks at about 94 t/h, so it is saturated. LH-10 is in the workshop and I did not move it. Este: TJ-E543-11 (8.3 g/t) has 269 t of broken ore left (368 t at the start of the shift minus 99 t mucked). LH-05 alone mucks about 33 t/h × 6.5 h of loading time, about 215 t, which leaves about 54 t unmucked. Este has 3 trucks at about 78 t/h, which is more than enough, so the ore can be hauled. I lend LH-08 from DS-C538-01, an infrastructure heading worth only 0.2 oz/h. Travel is about 0.5 h and it can muck the 54 t within about 2.3 h at 23.6 t/h. Gain is 54 t × 8.3 g/t ÷ 31.1 = about 14.4 oz, less about 1.2 oz of development loss, so about +13 oz net. I did not touch DS-E543-02, the critical-path heading worth 4 oz/h, and I activated no reserves, since no stope has been stopped. Radio and CMMS both show LH-03 down, so the confirmation call is a precaution rather than a rule trigger.
